title: iPSC gDNA Extraction for Screening Edited Clones
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8afrse

steps.title: Centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Spin the 96‑well PCR plate at 3800 rpm for 30 seconds at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant; if cell loss is a concern, transfer it with a multichannel pipette into a new PCR plate and store at –20 °C until DNA extraction is complete.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a new PCR plate and store at –20 °C until DNA extraction is complete (optional, if worried about removing cells).

steps.title: Add QuickExtract
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL QuickExtract DNA Solution (Epicentre Technologies, catalog QE09050) directly to the cell pellet (often not visible).

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 65 °C for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Vortex again
steps.instruction: Vortex the plate for another 15 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate at 98 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in a thermocycler at 98 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Store at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the plate at –20 °C for storage until further screening experiments are performed.
